author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets and character drawing
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists, and invests in human made work consistently!! Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing, but send your portfolios of comics art so he can see who’s out here! You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates for consideration along with your samples if requested! Potential for additional work as needed down the line if it goes well! He’s added as contributor to this post, so he can go through the comments as you drop your info. COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL!
